assistant.instructions: Browse the user's scraped Spotify home (playlists grouped by section — Daily Mixes, Made For You, …). Content comes from periodic syncs, not live Spotify. TO PLAY: use the host's home-shelf verbs (GET /v1/home/shelves → POST /v1/home/shelf → POST /v1/home/play) — they handle lazy track resolution and backfill; playback rides other resolvers (usually yt-dlp). These tools are for READING the catalog first: status (is anything synced), list_playlists, get_playlist_tracks (serves the cache, scraping lazily on a miss — can take tens of seconds). Catalog lookups (live, each opens a hidden Spotify page — 10–30s): get_album_tracks (an album's full tracklist in order), get_track_plays (Spotify's all-time play count for a song), get_artist_listeners (an artist's monthly listeners). Spotify shows no per-track listener figure; per-track listeners are a Last.fm stat.

tools.name: status
tools.description: What the Spotify scraper knows: playlist count, section names, sync state, last check time

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.description: The scraped playlists (id, name, section, cached track count), optionally one section's

section.description: Filter to one section name (from status)

tools.name: get_playlist_tracks
tools.description: A playlist's tracks (title/artist/album). Served from cache; an unfetched playlist is scraped lazily — slow (tens of seconds)

tools.name: get_album_tracks
tools.description: An album's full tracklist from Spotify, in album order. Give the album name, or a track title to use that track's album. Live lookup — slow (10–30s)

title.description: A track on the album — used when the album name is unknown, or as the fallback for compilations

tools.name: get_track_plays
tools.description: Spotify's all-time play count for a song. found:false when Spotify has no match or shows no count (it hides counts under ~1,000 plays). Live lookup — slow

tools.name: get_artist_listeners
tools.description: An artist's current monthly listeners on Spotify (exact name match only). Live lookup — slow
